name: The Vintage Train Passing Through a Field of Golden Wheat
description: A classic steam train with warm, glowing windows traveling along a track that cuts through a vast, undulating field of golden wheat under a purple twilight sky.
prompt: A classic, vintage steam train with warm, glowing yellow windows traveling along a track that cuts through a vast, undulating field of golden wheat. The sky is painted in rich shades of purple, violet, and deep blue of twilight, with the first stars beginning to appear. The train emits a soft, white steam that catches the twilight light. Nostalgic, cinematic, beautiful.
caption: Chasing the twilight through endless fields of gold, carrying quiet dreams to distant stations. 🚂🌾
